answer: This is a Special Event Request Form addressed to K.A. Sparrow, dated April 9, 1996. The form is used to order sample packs of cigarettes (400 packs per case) from various brands including Newport, Kent, and True, in different sizes (King Size and 100's) and types (regular and lights). It also allows for ordering promotional items like water bottles and banners (4' x 8') in three market segments: General Market, Urban, and Spanish Language. The form includes a shipping section with a partial customer number (198-), requires 6 weeks for processing, and appears to be routed through the New York Office (NYO) to Promotion Services. All quantity fields and most header fields are left blank, suggesting this is an unfilled template.
